name: Blip
tagline: Send files to people and devices around the world
blurb: Blip lets you send any size photos, videos, and files to people and devices around the world.
description:
Blip lets you send any size photos, videos, and files to people and devices
around the world.

• One-click – Drag & drop or paste to send

• Direct – No separate uploading and downloading

• No size limits – Send original files and folders with no zipping

• Private – Files are end-to-end encrypted and never stored in the cloud

• Universal – Send between your phones, tablets, and computers

• Near & far – Works in the same room and over the internet

• Save locally – Choose any folder, on any connected drive

• Auto-resume – Keep your progress, no matter what happens

Blip is an internet utility and requires an account to use.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
